summary: ESO-60 (US-ARCH-04: Q3 Circular Dependency) implementation strictly satisfies all acceptance criteria (AC-ARCH-04-01 through AC-ARCH-04-05) and architectural invariants (INV-GR-01, INV-GR-02, INV-GR-03, BR-05). Cycle detection uses Tarjan's SCC algorithm on the directed adjacency graph of valid 'depends_on' edges with 0 fabricated relations. Diamond dependencies / shared libraries correctly yield 0 false positives. Completeness is calculated against K(Q3) = [module, package]; when coverage is below floor (0.70) or threshold (0.90), status returns 'unknown' with LOW_COVERAGE and never asserts clean or absent (BR-05). Graphs with 0 depends_on edges explicitly return 'không có vòng' accompanied by coverage metrics (AC-ARCH-04-04). Dangling depends_on edges pointing to deleted modules are safely pruned and surfaced under unknowns as DANGLING_MODULE without triggering false cycles (AC-ARCH-04-05). Multi-project boundary isolation is strictly enforced (INV-GR-03). All file edits conform to plan allowed_files bounds for S1 (eso/graph/**) and S2 (qc/eso-graph-*.test.mjs). 0 critical findings, 0 minor findings.
